summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 continues to trend downward, with capable mid-tier models (GPT-4o mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Haiku) now priced well under $1 per million input tokens, while flagship models cluster between $2–$15 per million input tokens. Prompt caching and batch processing (typically ~50% discounts) have become near-universal cost levers, and the output-to-input price spread remains large (often 4–5x). Note that much of the live research data references speculative future models and introductory pricing; this table reflects only models publicly available today with confirmed published pricing from official vendor pages.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers 50% discount. Prompt caching discounts apply automatically to repeated context.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost model for high-volume tasks. Batch API 50% discount available.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching reads at ~10% of input cost; cache writes cost more. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available via Google AI Studio (content may be used to improve products). Batch requests half price.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Higher price tier (>200K prompt): $2.50 in / $15 out. Free tier via AI Studio. Batch requests half price.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model. Output price includes reasoning tokens. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fastest, lowest-cost Claude model. Prompt caching and 50% batch discount available.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Advanced reasoning model; price was reduced significantly in 2025. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Flagship, highest-capability Claude model. Prompt caching reads ~10% of input. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: Grok 4
models.notes: Higher context tier (>128K) priced higher. Prompt caching available.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free tier available via La Plateforme for experimentation with rate limits. Batch API discount available.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost model. Free tier available via La Plateforme with rate limits.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
models.notes: Hosted on Groq's LPU infrastructure for very high throughput. Free tier with rate limits available.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Together AI)
models.notes: Hosted open-weight model; turbo variants available. Free credits on signup.

models.name: Llama 3.1 405B (Fireworks)
models.notes: Largest open Llama model hosted on Fireworks. Free trial credits available.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Optimized for RAG and tool use. Free trial API keys available with rate limits.
